R3 ENCRYPTED: the encryptedRefusal fixture is doc-clean's real answer for an encrypted PDF, a refusal by code with nothing copied
R1 the format is judged from the bytes alone: pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, a macro-enabled twin named by its plain twin, odt, ods, odp, html and text
R1 CSV and plain text answer clean:true with nothing else; an HTML document without a data:image URI too
R1 a copy answers its bytes, its format and the counts of images stripped and left unchanged
R1 R6 a document carrying neither image metadata nor document metadata answers clean:true: a PDF, a .docx, an ODF package
R1 never throws: any value, empty, truncated or random bytes answer a refusal
R2 a PDF copy: its JPEG carries no EXIF, XMP or comment, its coded data unchanged, and no image /Metadata
R2 a PDF copy is the latest revision rewritten whole: an incrementally replaced image is gone, and every object it defines is reachable from its trailer
R2 a PDF copy expands object streams and strips a page's /Thumb image
R2 a JPEG 2000 image's xml box is stripped, in a PDF (JPXDecode) and in a package
R2 a package copy is the same parts in the same order, only image and metadata parts changed, every part at the fixed time with no extra field and no comment
R2 a package's JPEG and PNG keep their coded data byte for byte; an EMZ's gzip header loses its name and time
R3 ENCRYPTED: a PDF with a Standard security handler, an encrypted OOXML compound file, an ODF manifest listing encrypted parts
R3 EMBEDDED_FILE: a PDF attachment (name tree and annotation), an OOXML embeddings/ part, a vbaProject.bin, an ODF embedded Object, each named
R3 IMAGE_NOT_CLEANABLE: TIFF, HEIC, AVIF and JPEG XL images; EMF and WMF holding a JPEG or PNG; SVG with <image> or <metadata>; a PDF inline JPEG; a BMP with a colour profile
R3 HTML_EMBEDS_IMAGE, ARCHIVE and NOT_A_CLEANABLE_FORMAT
R3 DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE: a file over CLEAN_MAX_BYTES, nothing read; a part declaring more than CLEAN_MAX_PART_BYTES
R3 DOCUMENT_UNREADABLE: a dangling PDF reference, a content stream that cannot be decoded, a part failing its CRC, a duplicated part
R3 each refusal of image-cover's stripMetadata is relayed under its own code, naming the image
R6 a PDF copy: no trailer /Info, no catalog XMP, no annotation /T, /M or /CreationDate (a widget's field name kept), no signer's identity, the signature field unsigned

R6 a .docx copy: core and app properties emptied of every named field and still valid, custom.xml removed with its relationship and override, comment and change authors, initials and dates emptied, their text kept
R6 Word's people, settings template, PowerPoint's and Excel's comment authors, Excel's shared-workbook names and folder path are emptied
R6 an ODF copy: meta.xml's named fields removed and the part kept valid, annotations' and tracked changes' creator and date emptied, their text kept
R6 the edits find each namespace by the prefix the part declares, in either quote, in UTF-16 too, and leave comments, CDATA and every other byte as they were
R3 EMBEDDED_MEDIA: a video or audio part (MP4, QuickTime, WAV, MP3, Ogg, WebM), a PDF RichMedia, 3D, screen or sound object, each named
R6 K2351 OOXML printer settings and custom XML parts are removed with their relationships, overrides and r:id references
R6 K2351 an EMF's description, an SVG's editor-namespace markup and a legacy Excel comment's leading author run are removed; the pictures and the comment's own text kept
R6 K2351 a JBIG2 image's and its globals' comment segments are dropped, every other segment kept byte for byte
R7 pure and deterministic: the same bytes answer the same bytes, alone, repeated or interleaved, and the input is not changed
R8 never a partial copy: one image that cannot be stripped among good ones refuses the whole document, with no bytes
